src: 2x2 input blocks s ordered bottom-right to top-left in reverse row-major order
dst: nested corner-fill layers d in the four output quadrants, ordered from each quadrant corner inward
transform: use s.top_left, s.top_right, s.bottom_left, and s.bottom_right as the upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, and lower-right quadrant layer colors
grid_shape: square with side twice the longer input dimension
